$comment: The three-route rule. Every SDK replays these cases and must produce the same route. This is the file that stops seven SDKs from drifting apart on the one computation that matters.

cases.name: frank confidence above the act threshold
confidence exactly at the act threshold: the threshold is INCLUSIVE
a hair below the act threshold: propose, do not act
confidence exactly at the confirm threshold: inclusive as well
below the confirm threshold: Toli does not know, a human takes over
score: same rule, the returned value does not affect the route
noul frankly NO: a confident no is worth a confident yes (certainty = 0.96)
noul at perfect doubt: 0.5 is the admission of ignorance, NEVER an action
lukewarm noul on the yes side: certainty = 0.4, below confirm
noul whose certainty lands exactly on the confirm threshold (0.8 → 0.6)
symmetric noul: 0.2 yields the same certainty as 0.8

advisory.$comment: Advisory mode: no ACT route exists, whatever the confidence. This is what clinical use rests on — screening and orientation for sickle-cell disease, haemophilia and rare diseases.

cases.name: certainty far above any act threshold still only proposes
certainty at the usual act threshold still only proposes
below confirm: escalate to a qualified human
